description: Read one authorization with its ID and the access token returned when it was sent, or the token in an emailed link: payment, status and next step, the payer's case number and its latest words (what it asked for, or its reason for a denial), the approval (units, start and end dates, authorization number), the units used and the day the next authorization is prepared, the clinical documents sent, and every step with its date, route and who did it. Statuses: awaiting_payment, received, submitted, pending, info_requested (what the payer asked for is in payer_note), approved (approved units, start and end dates, authorization number), denied (the reason is in payer_note), expired.

access_token.description: The access_token prior_authorization_request returned (shown once), or the token in an emailed link.

name: prior_authorization_status
title: Read an authorization follow-up
